litigation.mdlName: In re: Roblox Corporation Child Sexual Exploitation and Assault Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of California

phase: Pretrial: arbitration motions being briefed; no trial date
phaseDetail: The court is first deciding whether bellwether plaintiffs' claims must go to arbitration. A May 18, 2026 order set a fall 2026 briefing schedule for Roblox's and Discord's bellwether motions to compel arbitration, with the hearing to be set by the court; the public record reviewed does not show a ruling. Defenses under Section 230 and the First Amendment are also expected to be litigated. No trial date or settlement program has been announced; in April 2026 the court gave notice that it intends to appoint a settlement master to mediate.

settlements.label: No settlement program announced
settlements.detail: No global settlement or public payout schedule was identified in records reviewed October 17, 2026. An April 16, 2026 notice says the court intends to appoint Thomas J. Perrelli as settlement master, solely to mediate settlement discussions.
settlements.source: Notice of intent to appoint settlement master (Apr. 16, 2026)
settlements.individualClaims: No official individual payout amounts have been published.

keyDates.label: MDL-3166 created
keyDates.detail: The JPML centralized 31 actions from 12 districts, with nearly 80 actions and potential tag-alongs in 18 districts, before Judge Richard Seeborg. Roblox, Discord, Snap and Meta had opposed centralization.

keyDates.label: Plaintiffs' co-lead counsel appointed
keyDates.detail: Order appointing plaintiffs' co-lead counsel and directing the parties to meet and confer (Dkt. 137).
keyDates.source: Court order, Dkt. 137 (copy posted by plaintiffs' counsel)

keyDates.label: Notice of intent to appoint settlement master
keyDates.detail: The court gave notice that it intends to appoint Thomas J. Perrelli to mediate settlement discussions. He would not decide any issues in the case.
keyDates.source: Notice, Dkt. 301 (copy posted by plaintiffs' counsel)

keyDates.label: Arbitration-motion briefing schedule set
keyDates.detail: Order sets September 8 for Roblox's and Discord's bellwether motions to compel arbitration, October 13 for oppositions and November 10 for replies, with the hearing to be set by the court.
keyDates.source: Order, Dkt. 342 (copy posted by plaintiffs' counsel)
